title: Hours of fun!
text: Hours of fun!. I got these for my grandchildren for when they visited me in Central Florida this past July. What fun! These were safe enough to be able to throw around inside the house without damage to any of my knick-knacks or furniture. These look and feel (ok, not in temperature but texture) like real snowballs. My grandchildren are 6 and 4 years old and I actually bought another set and sent it to their home in California for them to play with when they are home. Highly recommend for good fun (without the damage).
